name: agent-shuriken
description: Careful plugins for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: account-cleanup
plugins.description: Find web accounts you no longer use without reading any passwords, then cancel subscriptions and delete the accounts you approve

plugins.name: compare-report
plugins.description: Research the candidates for a choice and write an HTML and PDF comparison report, with a source for every claim and a rationale for every score

plugins.name: diagram-explainer
plugins.description: Write an explainer as one HTML file with a figure drawn in every section, built from JSON and checked before you share it

plugins.name: docs-publish
plugins.description: Write the public documentation of an open source project in five parts, Quickstart, Concepts, API reference, Cookbook, and FAQ, in English and a second language you pick, with every page's translation and every relative link checked

plugins.name: excalidraw-diagram
plugins.description: Draw architecture, flow, sequence, and ER diagrams as Excalidraw files laid out by a script, checked for overlaps, crowded spacing, and labels on lines, with SVG and PNG copies and no downloads

plugins.name: feedback-loop
plugins.description: When you correct an agent's work, record the correction, fix the files, have an evaluator that edits nothing judge the fix, and repeat until it passes, keeping the lesson as a check or a rule for next time

plugins.name: init-project
plugins.description: Set up a project for local work: pick a free local port, add a Docker setup, and link its env files to 1Password with references, writing each file only after you approve it

plugins.name: learning-to-skill
plugins.description: Write the lessons from a session into the instruction files your agents read, such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, Copilot's instructions, or a skill's SKILL.md, in the right place and without duplicates, only after you approve the diff

plugins.name: portman
plugins.description: Keep a registry of the localhost ports each project uses, so dev servers never collide: see what holds each port right now, get free ports that avoid common defaults, find collisions, and write a project's ports to .env.local and a Docker Compose override after you approve

plugins.name: repo-progress
plugins.description: See where every repository you work on stands in one table: worktrees, open issues and pull requests, uncommitted files, and which ones have stalled, without changing anything

plugins.name: secure-dotfile
plugins.description: Find API keys and tokens written into your shell startup files and move the ones you pick into the macOS Keychain, without the agent seeing any value

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Hand an agent session over to a new one: a short message to paste, and a saved state of the options already rejected, the current phase, delegated work, and things not to do, with anything that looks like a secret refused

plugins.name: techdebt
plugins.description: Rank the files most worth fixing by combining how often they change with their size, old TODO comments, missing tests, long functions, and duplication, without downloading anything
